d:
A shocking firing incident has been reported from Madhubani, Bihar, where an ASI allegedly opened fire on villagers with his service pistol.
One villager, identified as 50-year-old Ashok Yadav, died in the firing, while three others were injured.
The incident allegedly took place after villagers surrounded the ASI at a house where he had reportedly gone late at night.
After Ashok Yadav’s death, angry villagers protested and a woman allegedly grabbed the collar of Madhubani DM Anand Sharma.
